question: Why did the error rate go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of catalog v4.0 introduced a NullPointerException.
why_chain: The error rate increased after the deployment of catalog v4.0.
The NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.0) caused the error.
The error occurred 1 minute after the deployment, indicating the change was the cause.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of catalog v4.0 was not followed by a routine release.
why_chain: The error rate increased after the deployment of catalog v4.0.
There was no routine release of catalog v4.0, which could have mitigated the issue.
The error occurred 1 minute after the deployment, indicating the change was the cause.

contributing_factors.description: The error rate increase is localized to the service catalog in region eu-west.
why_chain: The error rate increase is concentrated in the service catalog in region eu-west.
The error rate increase is not seen in other service/region segments.
The error rate increase is localized to the service catalog in region eu-west.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment of catalog v4.0 was the only change made to the service catalog in region eu-west.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region eu-west rose from 0.40% to 3.34% (+729%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T04:45:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (567 per 5 min before, 647 per 5 min after, +14%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (120 ms before, 121 ms after, +1%).
Deployed catalog v4.0 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 1 min before the change; record R015)
High error rate on catalog in eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 10 min after the change; record R018)
Deployed catalog v3.10 to eu-west (routine release) (catalog, eu-west; 98 min before the change; record R014)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.0) (catalog, eu-west; 1 min after the change; record R016)
Deployed catalog v2.24 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 206 min before the change; record R012)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (1 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the deployment of catalog v4.0 to eu-west.
Implement a more robust error handling mechanism in RequestHandler.serialize.
Schedule routine releases for the service catalog in region eu-west.
